sentences.zh: 我有几次待在“飞与杰”货车加油站。

sentences.en: I parked there, and I don't even know if they're still offering showers, but I could pay to take a shower for $12.
sentences.zh: 我把车停在那儿，我甚至不知道他们现在还提供淋浴没有，但我以前可以花12美元洗个澡。

sentences.en: So you were going to a truck stop to shower for $12?
sentences.zh: 所以你要去卡车驿站花12美元洗澡？

sentences.en: Yeah, at first I was staying there.
sentences.zh: 对，一开始我住在那里。

sentences.en: But, like, today, most of the bathrooms are closed.
sentences.zh: 但是，比如今天，大部分厕所都关门了。

sentences.en: There's just no place to go.
sentences.zh: 根本没地方去。

sentences.en: And sometimes when I went to sleep, I just wanted to stay asleep because I didn't know what to do with myself.
sentences.zh: 有时候我睡着了，就只想一直睡下去，因为我不知道该拿自己怎么办。

sentences.en: I don't know, just, just, it was just scary.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，就是，就是，太吓人了。

sentences.en: A lot of things ran through my head.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里闪过了很多想法。

sentences.en: I called for resources and talked to this lady.
sentences.zh: 我打了求助热线，跟一位女士聊了聊。

sentences.en: She said, well, maybe we can put you in a hotel for a day or so.
sentences.zh: 她说，好吧，也许我们可以给你安排一天左右的酒店。

sentences.en: And I was happy with that.
sentences.zh: 我听了挺高兴的。

sentences.en: But she called me back, and she told me that they had me in a room.
sentences.zh: 但她回电话告诉我，他们给我安排好房间了。

sentences.en: And I came in, I checked in, they gave me the rules, and I've been here ever since.
sentences.zh: 我过来了，办理了入住，他们跟我讲了规矩，我从那以后就一直呆在这儿。

sentences.en: And it's, it's awesome.
sentences.zh: 而且，太棒了。

sentences.en: It's great to have a place to go, you know.
sentences.zh: 有个地方可去，这感觉真好。

sentences.en: And my cat, my cat, just like, you should have seen her when she went into the room.
sentences.zh: 我的猫，我的猫，真的是，你真该看看她进房间时的样子。

sentences.en: She was like in heaven.
sentences.zh: 她就像进了天堂一样。

sentences.en: I, I buy her little treats.
sentences.zh: 我，我会给她买点小零食。

sentences.en: I buy her little toys just because, you know, she went through hell, too.
sentences.zh: 我会给她买小玩具，因为，你知道的，她也经历了一场浩劫。

sentences.en: And nobody could take care of her but me.
sentences.zh: 除了我，没人能照顾她。

sentences.en: And I'm not doing a very good job.
sentences.zh: 而我其实没把它照顾好。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I, I leave here Friday.
sentences.zh: 我周五就要离开这里了。

sentences.en: And I don't know what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: And I'm going to be back out there again.
sentences.zh: 我又得回到那种生活中去了。

sentences.en: And I'm having a hard time.
sentences.zh: 我很难过。

sentences.en: I, you know, I'm having a hard time with that.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道的，我很难接受这一点。

sentences.en: But, um, last week I found a job.
sentences.zh: 不过，嗯，上周我找到了一份工作。

sentences.en: My friend, she worked for Constantino's for years.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友在康斯坦蒂诺超市干了好多年。

sentences.en: Supermarket?
sentences.zh: 超市吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so, me and her went down there together.
sentences.zh: 所以，我和她一起去了那儿。

sentences.en: And she spoke with them.
sentences.zh: 她跟他们谈了谈。

sentences.en: And we had to go back a couple days later because we had to talk to corporate.
sentences.zh: 我们几天后还得回去，因为得跟总公司的人谈。

sentences.en: It took me forever to get ready.
sentences.zh: 我花了老半天时间才收拾好。

sentences.en: It's hard to do in your car, especially when it's raining, when your clothes are in your trunk.
sentences.zh: 在车里很难弄，特别是下雨的时候，衣服都在后备箱里。

sentences.en: Getting ready and dressed in the back seat.
sentences.zh: 在后座上收拾打扮。

sentences.en: Washing your hair out of a milk jug, you know, water jug.
sentences.zh: 用牛奶壶，你知道的，水壶里的水洗头。

sentences.en: Brushing your teeth.
sentences.zh: 刷牙。

sentences.en: Trying to find something to wear out of the trunk of my car.
sentences.zh: 试图从车后备箱里找出能穿的衣服。

sentences.en: Or, but, you know, I don't know where my birth certificate is or my social security card.
sentences.zh: 或者，但是，你知道的，我不知道我的出生证明或社保卡放在哪儿。

sentences.en: And I thought that I could use my passport.
sentences.zh: 我以为我可以用护照。

sentences.en: My passport expired.
sentences.zh: 但我的护照过期了。

sentences.en: So, she couldn't accept that.
sentences.zh: 所以，她没法接受这个。

sentences.en: But, it's just pinning my birth certificate.
sentences.zh: 不过，只是在找我的出生证明。

sentences.en: Okay, gotcha.
sentences.zh: 好，明白了。

sentences.en: And my friend that got me the job, she's worked like seven days straight right now.
sentences.zh: 帮我找到工作的那个朋友，她现在已经连续工作七天了。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so, I just see her go to work every day.
sentences.zh: 所以，我看着她每天去上班。

sentences.en: I'm like, dang, I want to go, I want to go.
sentences.zh: 我就想，天哪，我也想去，我也想去。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费体验《时报》一个月，还不需要绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你的第一个月应用体验是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，享受30天免费阅读权。

sentences.en: I'm Alan Foyer.
sentences.zh: 我是艾伦·福耶尔。

sentences.en: I'm a reporter for the New York Times Metro Desk.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》都市新闻部的记者。

sentences.en: A couple of weeks ago, I had spoken to an inmate named Foster Thompson.
sentences.zh: 几周前，我采访了一位名叫福斯特·汤普森的服刑人员。

sentences.en: Foster is a 55-year-old New Yorker who was arrested and sent to prison for a murder on Staten Island in 1992.
sentences.zh: 福斯特今年55岁，是一名纽约人，他在1992年因斯滕岛的一起谋杀案被捕入狱。

sentences.en: He's been in the state prison system ever since, and recently he's been at Sing Sing for the last three years, where there have been, according to state officials,
sentences.zh: 从那以后他一直待在州立监狱系统中，最近三年他被关在新新监狱，根据州官员的数据，

sentences.en: at least two cases of the coronavirus in the prison population.
sentences.zh: 监狱内至少出现了两起冠状病毒感染病例。

sentences.en: So, anyhow, we're expecting a call from Foster in the next few minutes, and he's going to tell us about conditions in Sing Sing right now.
sentences.zh: 所以，总之，我们预计在接下来的几分钟内会接到福斯特的电话，他将向我们讲述新新监狱目前的状况。

sentences.en: Can you hear me, Foster?
sentences.zh: 福斯特，你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, I can hear you.
sentences.zh: 能，能，我能听到。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 听得到。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: So it's Monday morning, and I just wonder if you could describe for me where you are now and what's around you.
sentences.zh: 现在是周一早晨，我想请你描述一下你现在在哪儿，你周围是什么样的。

sentences.en: Well, right now I'm in a little, like, phone booth room, and I'm on the fourth floor in Building 8.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我现在在一个类似小电话亭的房间里，我在8号楼的四楼。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Now, how long have you been in the state prison system?
sentences.zh: 你在州立监狱系统待了多久了？

sentences.en: Since 94.
sentences.zh: 从94年开始。

sentences.en: How do these last couple of weeks compare to other, you know, crisis times in your time in prison?
sentences.zh: 跟你在监狱里经历的其他危机时期相比，过去这几周怎么样？

sentences.en: People was more panicked in here.
sentences.zh: 这里的人更恐慌了。

sentences.en: Dudes was yelling last night, and a few were this morning.
sentences.zh: 昨晚有人在大喊大叫，今天早上也有几个。

sentences.en: You know, they're not testing nobody, but it's corona.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们谁也不检测，但这就是新冠。

sentences.en: You know they don't give a F about us.
sentences.zh: 你知道他们根本不在乎我们的死活。

sentences.en: But, yeah, last night you had, like, at least it sounded like from four different areas, you know, coughing and sneezing all night, you know, literally all night.
sentences.zh: 但是，对啊，昨晚你有听到，至少听起来像是从四个不同的区域传来的咳嗽声和喷嚏声，整晚都在咳嗽，你知道的，真的是整晚。

sentences.en: You know, like, I got asthma.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我有哮喘。

sentences.en: You know, I had it all my life, you know.
sentences.zh: 我一辈子都有哮喘，你知道的。

sentences.en: I also had a collapsed lung.
sentences.zh: 我还曾经肺塌陷过。

sentences.en: So, you know, I worry about it all the time.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我无时无刻不在担心。

sentences.en: But I cleaned myself thoroughly, constantly, to wipe the bars down and, you know, the gates.
sentences.zh: 但我不断地彻底清洁自己，擦拭铁栏杆，还有，你知道的，铁门。

sentences.en: I washed my hands and stuff thoroughly.
sentences.zh: 我彻底洗手什么的。

sentences.en: I probably, like, 50-something times a day.
sentences.zh: 我大概一天洗个五十多次吧。

sentences.en: I mean, this is literally seriously.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这绝对是认真的。

sentences.en: It's not just exaggerated.
sentences.zh: 不只是夸张。

sentences.en: You know, use the dull soap and that Ajax dishwashing liquid to kill bacteria.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，用普通的肥皂和那种艾杰斯洗洁精来杀菌。

sentences.en: That's the best I could do.
sentences.zh: 这是我能做到最好的了。

sentences.en: You know, when I'm in the yard, I try to stay my distance of it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在操场放风时，我尽量跟人保持距离。

sentences.en: You know, when I've got to go to the phone, I mean, you've got no choice.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当我要去打电话时，我是说，你别无选择。

sentences.en: I've got a couple of socks that I wash out that I use, you know, use the socks to cover the whole phone when I'm talking on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我有几双洗干净的袜子可以用，你知道的，用袜子把整个话筒包起来再打电话。

sentences.en: You know, you can't avoid nobody here.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在这里你谁也避不开。

sentences.en: You know, it's just totally, totally impossible.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这完全、完全不可能。

sentences.en: How many people have been using these phones recently?
sentences.zh: 最近有多少人在用这些电话？

sentences.en: The ones in the yard, you know, everybody, every day that uses the phones constantly.
sentences.zh: 操场上的那些，你知道的，每个人，每天都在不停地用电话。

sentences.en: You know, it could be 400 guys out there at a given time.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，任何时候外面都可能有400个家伙。

sentences.en: And everybody is piled up on top of each other.
sentences.zh: 而且每个人都挤在一起。

sentences.en: I mean, literally, side by side, right behind your head, you know, everybody's standing bunched up there waiting to, you know, hear their name call to get on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我是说，真的是肩并肩，就在你脑后，你知道的，每个人都挤在那儿等着，你知道的，听到叫自己的名字就去打电话。

sentences.en: Have the phone calls increased because of the decision to cut off prison visitation?
sentences.zh: 因为取消监狱探视的决定，打电话的人变多了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, most definitely.
sentences.zh: 对，绝对是。

sentences.en: Most definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: But they do have, you know, some bleach and water solution that they squirt on the rag and they wipe the phones off.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实有，你知道的，一些漂白水和水的混合溶液，他们把它喷在抹布上用来擦电话。

sentences.en: Every 23 guys get off, they wipe it down before the next ones get on.
sentences.zh: 每23个人打完电话，他们在下一拨人使用前都会擦拭一遍。

sentences.en: So they is doing that.
sentences.zh: 所以他们确实在这么做。

sentences.en: Now, you said you've washed your hands compulsively.
sentences.zh: 刚才你说你一直在强迫性地洗手。

sentences.en: You're worried.
sentences.zh: 你很担心。

sentences.en: And yet you go out to the yard phone to use that phone.
sentences.zh: 然而你还是要走到操场上去用那部电话。

sentences.en: Why do those calls matter to you so much at this point, Foster?
sentences.zh: 福斯特，为什么在这个时候，这些电话对你来说那么重要？

sentences.en: You know, because it's been let my wife and my kids know that I'm all right.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，因为这能让我的妻子和孩子们知道我一切都好。

sentences.en: And I can't even express, you know, how they feel like if they don't hear from me, especially my wife and my daughter, they'd be in a panic.
sentences.zh: 而且我甚至无法表达，你知道的，如果他们听不到我的消息会是什么感觉，尤其是我的妻子和女儿，她们会陷入恐慌。

sentences.en: Honestly, you know, they need me to call.
sentences.zh: 老实说，你知道的，他们需要我打电话。

sentences.en: You know, I need to hear from them just as much.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我也同样需要听到他们的消息。

sentences.en: Just crazy, man.
sentences.zh: 简直疯了，伙计。

sentences.en: I am really feeling that, you know, the way, you know, it's going in here.
sentences.zh: 我真的能感觉到，你知道的，那种情况，你知道的，在这里发展的方向。

sentences.en: Like, it's just, it seemed like it's just a matter of time before it spread all through this place, you know.
sentences.zh: 就像是，感觉这只是时间问题，它就会蔓延到这里的每一个角落，你知道的。

sentences.en: Well, look, Foster, we really appreciate your taking time to do this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，听着，福斯特，我们真的很感激你抽出时间来做这件事。

sentences.en: And please stay safe, okay?
sentences.zh: 请注意安全，好吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: I'm trying, man.
sentences.zh: 我在努力，伙计。

sentences.en: That's number one.
sentences.zh: 那是第一位的。

sentences.en: Try to stay safe and stay healthy in this place, man, you know.
sentences.zh: 在这个地方努力保持安全和健康，伙计，你知道的。

sentences.en: Thanks, Foster.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，福斯特。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Some of the stories that I have taking care of patients, just jot them down.
sentences.zh: 我把照顾病人时的一些故事简单记了下来。

sentences.en: It's kind of like those old chicken soup for the soul.
sentences.zh: 这有点像那些老版的《心灵鸡汤》。

sentences.en: You just jot down little things that took your heart or that was really special to you or really sad or hard for you.
sentences.zh: 你只是记下那些触动你心灵的小事，或者对你来说非常特别、非常悲伤、很难熬的事情。

sentences.en: And so I started doing that years ago is where I just would drop down.
sentences.zh: 所以我几年前就开始这么做了，就是把它们随手记下来。

sentences.en: I'm Mike Baker, a reporter based in Seattle.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克·贝克，一名常驻西雅图的记者。

sentences.en: And a couple of weeks ago, I spoke to Tammy Wiatrowski, a nurse at the hospital that faced really the initial brunt of coronavirus cases and deaths in the United States.
sentences.zh: 几周前，我采访了塔米·维特罗夫斯基，她是美国一家医院的护士，这家医院当时正面临着冠状病毒病例和死亡病例的第一波猛烈冲击。

sentences.en: So at the end of a night that's hard, like an end of a 12-hour shift, I can get my pad, get my journal, and then just sit there and kind of process stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以在辛苦工作了一晚之后，比如结束了一场12小时的班次，我可以拿出我的记事本，我的日记本，然后坐在那里梳理一下思绪。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: When the virus first hit.
sentences.zh: 当病毒刚爆发的时候。

sentences.en: Then this hit and it was like, oh, I have this deep sinking.
sentences.zh: 接着疫情袭来，这种感觉就像，哦，我有一种深深的下沉感。

sentences.en: I just want to get this stuff out.
sentences.zh: 我只想把这些东西倾吐出来。

sentences.en: Tammy began a new journal to chronicle what was happening.
sentences.zh: 塔米开始写一本新日记来记录发生的事情。

sentences.en: So I asked her to read from it.
sentences.zh: 所以我请她读一读里面的内容。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So this was started Friday, February 28th.
sentences.zh: 所以这是从2月28日星期五开始的。

sentences.en: This was my first day of a four-day stretch as charged in our ICU.
sentences.zh: 这是我作为重症监护室（ICU）责任护士连续四天班的第一天。

sentences.en: That evening, we received the first two COVID-19 positive results in two of our patients, one who had just succumbed to the virus.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，我们收到了两名患者的2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）检测呈阳性的最初结果，其中一人刚刚死于该病毒。

sentences.en: As the evening nurses were making their way in for their shift, our infectious disease director, Dr. Rito,
sentences.zh: 正当夜班护士们走进病房准备交接时，我们的传染病主任里托医生，

sentences.en: came to let the staff know that the virus was here and that we had more patients that we needed to teSt.
sentences.zh: 来告知全体员工病毒已经到来，并且我们还有更多的病人需要检测。

sentences.en: I get emotional when I think about that night.
sentences.zh: 一想起那天晚上，我就情绪激动。

sentences.en: We all glanced across the room with a very blank look of shock on our faces.
sentences.zh: 我们都环视着房间，脸上带着一片茫然震惊的表情。

sentences.en: It was very surreal.
sentences.zh: 这一切非常超现实。

sentences.en: So, I immediately thought about my four grandsons that were supposed to have their monthly slumber party with Granny in two weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以，我立刻想到了我的四个孙子，他们本该在两周后和外婆举行每月的睡衣派对。

sentences.en: Knowing that I would have to make that call, letting them know that I wouldn't be able to have this month's slumber party, or maybe even the next.
sentences.zh: 一想到我不得不打那个电话，告诉他们我无法举办这个月的睡衣派对，甚至可能是下个月的派对，

sentences.en: That my newest little granddaughter of just a year and a half would look and act so much bigger in those next few weeks while I was unable to see her.
sentences.zh: 一想到我那才一岁半的小孙女，在我未来几周无法探望她的日子里，会长得那么大、变化那么快，

sentences.en: Looking around the room, looking around the room, at my other co-workers, I could tell they were probably thinking of their loved ones as well.
sentences.zh: 环顾房间，环顾四周的其他同事，我看得出他们可能也在想着自己的挚爱。

sentences.en: Then we all nodded our head as if saying yes.
sentences.zh: 然后我们都点了点头，仿佛在说“是的”。

sentences.en: Without a word said, it was just understood.
sentences.zh: 无需多言，一切尽在不言中。

sentences.en: Let's do this.
sentences.zh: 我们干吧。

sentences.en: The next several days and weeks at work became planned maneuvers like a well-oiled machine.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天和几周里，工作变得像一台运转良好的机器一样有计划地进行。

sentences.en: The nurses and doctors working so close together to isolate and treat these patients.
sentences.zh: 护士和医生们紧密合作，隔离和治疗这些患者。

sentences.en: Yet the art of nursing had changed.
sentences.zh: 然而，护理的艺术已经改变了。

sentences.en: As a nurse, I've always felt that if I couldn't help save a life and that patient dies, that I could help the family through the worst day of their life.
sentences.zh: 作为一名护士，我一直觉得如果我没能挽救一个生命，而那个病人去世了，我还能帮助家属度过他们一生中最艰难的一天。

sentences.en: And I still would go home feeling rewarded.
sentences.zh: 那我回家时仍然会感到欣慰。

sentences.en: I might cry all the way home or for weeks or months to come, but if I comfort the family and guide them through the process of grief,
sentences.zh: 我可能会一路哭着回家，或者在接下来的几周或几个月里都在哭，但如果我安慰了家属并引导他们度过悲伤的过程，

sentences.en: then I still feel like I've done something good, that I have cared, and that I've helped.
sentences.zh: 那么我仍然觉得自己做了一件好事，我付出了关怀，也给予了帮助。

sentences.en: Now, with how we have to isolate these patients, we are not able to have the families be with their loved ones as they pass.
sentences.zh: 现在，由于我们必须隔离这些患者，当挚爱离去时，家属无法陪伴在他们身边。

sentences.en: They don't get to spend the last few days of their life with them.
sentences.zh: 他们无法陪伴亲人度过生命的最后几天。

sentences.en: They don't get to hold their hand as they take their last breath.
sentences.zh: 在亲人咽下最后一口气时，他们无法握住他们的手。

sentences.en: As a nurse, I can't convey my sympathy and put my arms around them.
sentences.zh: 作为一名护士，我无法传达我的同情，也无法给他们一个拥抱。

sentences.en: At this point, I got mad.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，我生气了。

sentences.en: What can I give them?
sentences.zh: 我能给他们什么？

sentences.en: What last memory did we just change by having to protect them, both the family and the community?
sentences.zh: 为了保护他们——包括家属和社区，我们究竟改变了怎样的最后记忆？

sentences.en: These changes are needed under these circumstances, but they are changing the way a nurse provides the care and compassion during this time.
sentences.zh: 在这些情况下，这些改变是必要的，但它们正在改变护士在这段时期提供关怀和同情的方式。

sentences.en: Now we find ways to show our care and our hearts through the phone by telling them that we remind the patient that their family sends their love, that they called,
sentences.zh: 现在我们通过电话寻找表达关怀和爱心的方式，告诉他们，我们提醒病人说他们的家人送上了爱意，他们打过电话，

sentences.en: that they checked in, and that they love them.
sentences.zh: 他们询问过情况，他们爱他们。

sentences.en: And then later, on March 20th, I wrote,
sentences.zh: 后来，在3月20日，我写道：

sentences.en: My life changed.
sentences.zh: 我的生活变了。

sentences.en: I realized probably for the first time in my career, to help others has distanced me from the ones I love.
sentences.zh: 我可能在职业生涯中第一次意识到，为了帮助他人，我与我所爱的人疏远了。

sentences.en: Life is on pause.
sentences.zh: 生活暂停了。

sentences.en: At times, I'm jealous for some of the doctors and nurses that get to go home to their families and small children.
sentences.zh: 有时，我很嫉妒那些能够回家陪伴家人和小孩子的医生和护士。

sentences.en: As I walk by the kids' playroom, one of the bedrooms in my house, with the bunk beds and toys and video games, it's quiet.
sentences.zh: 当我走过孩子们的游戏室，也就是我家的其中一间卧室时，里面有双层床、玩具和电子游戏，四周一片寂静。

sentences.en: I don't hear the laughs and screams as the three youngest chase each other with Nerf guns.
sentences.zh: 我听不到三个最小的孩子拿着Nerf玩具枪互相追逐时的笑声和尖叫声。

sentences.en: Several times on my day off, I've walked by and looked into the room just to see their bunk beds empty, the pillows that say relax and love, and nobody's little head on them.
sentences.zh: 在我的休息日里，我曾好几次走过并往房间里看去，只看到他们的双层床空空如也，写着“放松”和“爱”的枕头上没有谁的小脑袋。

sentences.en: It makes me sad for a moment, but then I have to think, when this is over, we're going to have the biggest slumber party ever.
sentences.zh: 这让我难过了一会儿，但我转念一想，当这一切结束时，我们要举办有史以来最大的睡衣派对。

sentences.en: And they always know Granny loves them.
sentences.zh: 而且他们一直都知道外婆爱他们。

sentences.en: For that, I'm grateful.
sentences.zh: 为此，我很感激。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: A former Senate aide to Joe Biden has filed a criminal complaint over an alleged incident in which she says Biden sexually assaulted her in 1993, an allegation Biden denies.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登的一名前参议院助理就一桩涉嫌性侵事件提交了一起刑事控告，她称拜登于1993年对她实施了性侵，拜登对此指控予以否认。

sentences.en: The Times reports that a friend confirmed that the former aide, Tara Reid, told her the details of the allegation at the time, and that Reid told a second friend about it in 2008.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，一位朋友证实，前助理塔拉·里德当时曾向她讲述了指控的细节，里德还在2008年向第二位朋友提及此事。

sentences.en: But three former Biden staff members, who Reid said she reported the incident to, said they have no memory of such conversations,
sentences.zh: 但里德称曾向其汇报该事件的三名前拜登工作人员表示，他们对这样的谈话毫无记忆，

sentences.en: and a complaint that Reid said she filed to the Senate at the time, has not been found.
sentences.zh: 并且里德称当时向参议院提交的投诉也没有找到。

sentences.en: And over the weekend, the United States surpassed Italy in the total number of confirmed deaths from the coronavirus, more than 20,000.
sentences.zh: 在刚刚过去的周末，美国新冠肺炎确诊死亡总数超过2万例，超过了意大利。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in Britain, Prime Minister Boris Johnson was released from a London hospital after being treated in an intensive care unit for his infection.
sentences.zh: 与此同时在英国，英国首相鲍里斯·约翰逊在重症监护室接受感染治疗后，已从伦敦的一家医院出院。

sentences.en: Finally, in Italy, Pope Francis led an Easter vigil inside an almost empty St. Peter's Basilica,
sentences.zh: 最后在意大利，教皇方济各在几乎空无一人的圣彼得大教堂内主持了复活节守夜活动，

sentences.en: calling on his followers not to succumb to fear during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 呼吁信众在疫情期间不要向恐惧屈服。

sentences.en: Instead, the Pope called on Catholics around the world to be, quote, the messengers of life in a time of death.
sentences.zh: 相反，教皇呼吁世界各地的天主教徒成为，引述，“死亡时代中生命的信使”。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运转。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称是改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱有时又惊心动魄的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，我是主持人莎拉·科尼格，这里有关于人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
